name: Astronomy and Astrophysics II
description: Radiative transfer, specific intensity, photon distribution, stimulated/spontaneous emission, absorption, photoionization, collisional excitation, radiative equilibrium, local thermodynamic equilibrium. Black body radiation, CMB, spectral distortions, thermal bremsstrahlung, synchrotron radiation. Special relativity, Doppler shift, astrophysical jets, superluminal motion, relativistic cyclotron frequency. Jeans length, virial theorem, stellar equilibrium, timescales, mean free path, solar luminosity. Nuclear burning, Eddington luminosity, stellar pulsations, stellar structure, stellar evolution. Compton scattering, inverse Compton scattering. 21 cm radiation, Zeeman absorption, dispersion, Faraday rotation. Gravitational wave radiation, gravitational wave detection, electromagnetic counterparts.
